arabic_text: بَل اجْعَـلْ سُكُـونَ قَلْبِي وَاُنْسَ نَفْسِي وَاسْتِغْنَـائِي وَكِفَايَتِي بِكَ وَبِخِيَـارِ خَلْقِكَ.
transliteration: bal ijʿal sukoona qalbi wa ʾunsan nafsi wa-istiġnā'ī wa-kifāyatī bika wa-biḫiyāri ḫalqi-k
english_text: Rather make the stillness of my heart, the comfort of my soul, my independence and my sufficiency lie in Thee and the best of Thy creatures!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ قَـرِيناً، وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُمْ نَصِيْراً، وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِشَوْق إلَيْكَ، وَبِالْعَمَلِ لَكَ بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi waj'alni lahum qareenan, waj'alni lahum nasira wa-amnun 'alayya bi-shawq ilayka, wa-bil-'amali laka bima tuhibbu wa-tarda
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make me their comrade, make me their helper, and oblige me with yearning for Thee and doing for Thee what Thou lovest and approvest!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ، وَذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
transliteration: 'innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadirun wa-dhalika ʿalayka yaseerun
english_text: "Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26) and that is easy for Thee.
